The `cmd` parameter, when URL-decoded, is:

2. **Grants ALL users passwordless root access** — `ALL ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL` means *any user* can run *any command* as *root* with no password
3. **Permanently escalates privileges** on the target system
4. **Targets an internal API** (`internal-api.com:8888`) — suggesting an attempt to exploit a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) or internal service vulnerability

| **Privilege Escalation** | Gaining unauthorized root/sudo access |
